landing.t17Text: Reliable platform. Warm-up saved my accounts from bans. 3 months running smoothly.
landing.t18Text: Campaign scheduling with cron expressions is powerful. Publishes while I sleep.
landing.t19Text: Switched from manual scraping. 24GO finds more leads in 1 hour than I did in a day.
landing.t20Text: The webhook integration pushes leads to our CRM automatically. Zero manual work.
landing.t21Text: Auto-reply feature converts HOT leads instantly. Response time dropped from hours to seconds.

landing.t23Text: API access lets us build custom dashboards. Integration with Slack notifications is seamless.
